title: BETRAYAL
description: ARCHER has invited you into AEGIS, his private fortress. NEXUS is hunting you, and the trace alert is rising on its own.
goal: Reach ARCHER's private files before NEXUS catches you — then choose whom to believe.
hint: route aegis -> firewall -> login guest_op (see ~/aegis_access.txt) -> read the files in /archer

aegis_access.txt: 'come alone. NEXUS will notice. be fast.' — ARCHER

story_start: ARCHER: "I'm giving you nine minutes of safe passage. NEXUS knows you're coming. The alert will climb on its own."
MIRA: "Everything he'll show you is a half-truth. Please, {player}."
Your trace alert starts to rise by itself. Move.

objectives.text: Build a relay route to AEGIS

choice.prompt: You know what MIRA is. You know what ARCHER wants. You know what you were. Whom do you believe?

options.text: ARCHER. NEXUS cannot be argued with — only switched off.
MIRA. If she learned to care, so can the rest of NEXUS.
options.result: MIRA, softly: "Thank you. I won't forget this."

options.text: Nobody. The decision is yours alone.
options.result: A line from ZERO scrolls past: > good. that is exactly what i would have chosen.

story_end: The alert drops. Somewhere in the core, a very old process stops looking for you.

messages.text: > next: the core. root access. it's all there. i'll be with you.
